title: Modular compliance pack + retention toggle experiment with per-tenant SLA uplift
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Objective: Validate a modular addons strategy that bundles extended observability retention and a lightweight compliance pack, with an optional per-tenant SLA uplift (higher availability + response SLA) as a paid add-on. The experiment will test packaging, price points, and friction in the entitlement/onboarding flow for enterprise prospects.

Scope:
- Product: add two new add-ons: (1) Extended Observability Retention (30/90/365 days tiers), (2) Compliance Pack (SOC2+audit artifact export + contract questionnaire assistance).
- Upsell: optional SLA Uplift that guarantees lower tail latency and a 99.95% uptime SLA for a per-tenant monthly fee (implemented as priority routing + dedicated capacity qualifiers in routing policy).
- Billing: test two billing models in parallel: flat per-tenant monthly fee vs usage-linked (GB-month of stored telemetry + per-SLA uplift surcharge).
- Instrumentation: new entitlement flags, billing events, conversion funnel tracking, and per-tenant cost metrics.

Hypotheses:
1) A modular offering where observability retention is sold separately from compliance artifacts will increase addon conversion by >25% among mid-market customers evaluated in pilot.
2) Customers will prefer a flat monthly SLA uplift for predictability over a usage-linked surcharge.
3) Providing an onboarding checklist and automated contract questionnaire export will reduce time-to-first-purchase by at least 30%.

Primary success metrics (to instrument):
- Conversion rate from free to paid addon (30-day window).
- ARPA uplift attributable to addons (30/90/180 day cohorts).
- Time-to-first-paid-addon purchase after signup.
- Operational cost delta (additional infra spend per tenant) and net margin on addon revenue.
- Churn differential for tenants who enabled retention vs control.

Experiment design:
- Control: current bundled observability + telemetry baseline (no paid retention tiers).
- Arm A: Offer Extended Retention (30/90/365 days) as standalone paid addon (flat monthly tiers).
- Arm B: Offer Compliance Pack standalone (includes exportable evidence & questionnaire support) as paid addon.
- Arm C: Offer Retention + Compliance bundle with a discount and optional SLA Uplift CTA on billing page.
- Billing split test inside each arm: 50/50 flat monthly vs usage-linked billing.

Rollout plan:
1) Internal pilot with 10 qualifying mid-market customers (Nov 2025) — manual enablement and sales-assisted onboarding.
2) Close-loop feedback: collect sales notes, professional services effort, and legal questionnaire friction points.
3) Automate entitlement and billing flows for wider beta (Dec 2025).
4) Ramp to broader opt-in via Console toggle + pricing page (Jan 2026).

Implementation notes for engineering:
- Entitlements: add three boolean flags per-tenant: retention_tier, compliance_pack_enabled, sla_uplift_enabled. The entitlement must be readable by routing and billing services.
- Routing: SLA uplift should attach a routing tag that prefers dedicated pools or higher priority queues; if capacity unavailable, route to compatible fallback with notice to tenant.
- Billing: generate line-items for addon tier and SLA uplift surcharge; support both flat and usage-linked models for split testing.
- Observability: surface tenant-level storage usage and retention cost in Console for transparency.

Stakeholders:
- PM: Aisha Kapoor (owner), Sales Eng: Priya Rao, Legal: Daniel Park, Finance: Elena Rodriguez, Infra Eng: Marcus Chen, Console UX: Linh Vu, Security: Omar Haddad.

Dependencies: ["ENG-4482", "ENG-4620", "PM-25973", "FIN-301"],

Risks:
- Over-indexing on flat fees could misprice heavy telemetry tenants. Mitigation: meter and cap model in beta.
- SLA uplift may require additional dedicated capacity investment; if adoption low, cost could exceed revenue. Mitigation: start with soft SLA tiers and throttled dedicated routing; conservative capacity reservations.
- Legal/compliance expectations mismatch (customers expect audit support beyond scope). Mitigation: clear marketing & contract language, run a legal review on questionnaire deliverables.

Artifacts and links: ["https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Modular+Addons+Experiment+Spec", "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xAMPLE-retention-pricing-model", "https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/7892", "https://sheets.google.com/somepath/addon-pricing-model-v2"].
success_criteria: >25% addon conversion in pilot OR ARPA uplift >= $120/tenant/month net of additional infra costs; billing stability (no >0.5% payment failure uplift) and legal signoff on compliance deliverables.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal review + security/legal signoff (Oct-Nov). Phase 1: 10-customer pilot (Nov-Dec) with sales-assisted enablement. Phase 2: automated beta in Console + split billing test (Dec-Jan). Phase 3: public launch with pricing page and playbook for AE (Jan 2026).
risks_and_mitigations: Operational cost overruns: cap pilot enrollees and run daily cost monitoring; SLA capacity risk: implement auto-fallback with clear customer messaging; compliance scope creep: ship a 1.0 artifact export and add professional services for deeper audits.
